recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-43527 unless the work group later reopens the surrounding ImplementationGuide Scope and Usage text.
issue_request: FHIR-43527 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I R6 change request saying the ImplementationGuide Scope and Usage sentence ending "so that the logical package that the IG represents, so that the contents are computable" was unclear. The approved replacement says ImplementationGuide defines IG content and important entry pages as a single logical package so IG contents are computable for publication, validation, registry look-up, and other uses.
initial_application: Commit b32b2939b34eb543e75cad02bf187663b33a061b partially applied the change by replacing the unclear tail of the sentence. Commit 5ac21ed0d23493bde9815dba537d9cb0048132df, "FHIR-43527 Sentence not clear," then replaced the paragraph with the current wording that matches the Jira resolution while preserving readable source wrapping.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists implementationguide=ImplementationGuide, confirming that source/implementationguide/implementationguide-introduction.xml is in current build scope. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-03-04 record the 9-0-0 persuasive vote for FHIR-43527 and state that the same resolution also applies to FHIR-44129. The combined branch already had a no-change audit commit for FHIR-44129, but no commit with Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-43527 before this reconciliation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source says that ImplementationGuide defines the content of the IG, along with important entry pages into the publication, as a single logical package, so that the IG contents are computable for publication, validation, registry look-up, and other uses.

related_jiras.note: Same ImplementationGuide Scope and Usage sentence; FHIR-I minutes state FHIR-43527's resolution also applies to FHIR-44129, and a separate no-change audit commit already exists for that issue.
